title: A postcard to future you
summary: Celebrate National Recovery Month with a postcard to your future self. Download a design, write a note, and remember what treatment has given back.
body_markdown:
### A postcard to future you


Sometimes it helps to remember where you are now and imagine where you might be next.


For National Recovery Month, we asked Ophelia patients what treatment has given back to them. They told us about mornings with their kids, trust from family, more time, more freedom, feeling like themselves again, and the chance to simply experience the small everyday things in their lives. Their answers inspired us to make these postcards.


Choose a design that speaks to you, download and print it, then write a note to your future self. You might write about what you're proud of today, what you want to hold onto, or what you hope is waiting for you down the road.


Hold onto it, and come back to it when you're ready.


#### [Download your postcards](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/63235599a30434033ca3d1c3/6a959e7e5118f519aed5ddd8_Ophelia.NationalRecoveryMonth26_Postcards.pdf)


Wherever you are when you read it, we hope it reminds you how far you've come, and how much life there is ahead.


‍
